about: At Jose's word (5 November 2026): every time an agent looks stopped or late, the watcher opens an action here with what it found and what it recommends, addressed to Jose's conductor and to the agent's owner's conductor in its commit (For:). Every run re-checks each open action: closed when the agent commits again or its scheduled task is seen to fire; still open after two runs, it is raised again at the top of the commit. The watcher only reports and recommends; it never changes an agent, a task or a session (WS-129). An action's 'opened' is the run that first flagged the agent (12:15), before the loop existed.
